column1: # Legacy national-parameters file referenced by 04_diagnostics.py for the
# existence check. The authoritative source of these values is cz.yaml;
# this file mirrors them for documentation. All values are numeric.
# Czechia is a DIRECT EPISCOPE/TABULA country (CTU Prague / UCEEB; Lupisek
# et al.). The Czech EPISCOPE brochure calibrates intensities to the Czech
# reference climate (CSN 73 0540; ~3400 HDD; Praha-Ruzyne long-term mean);
# climate_multiplier scales actual CZ HDD (~3331) against that reference.
# Sources: Eurostat nrg_chdd_a (HDD); Czech EPISCOPE / Lupisek 2016 (retrofit
# factors; DHW); Czech LTRS 2020 + Nova zelena usporam (retrofit shares).
